en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century restaurant or café. The room has round tables covered with white tablecloths, wooden chairs, a large tiled fireplace with a decorative relief and vase of flowers on the mantel, wood‑paneled lower walls, and wall sconces. A prominent circular chandelier with shields or coat‑of‑arms motifs hangs from the ceiling. In the background, a second dining room is visible through an open partition, also with chandeliers and set tables. At the very top edge there is a handwritten note.
